# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.1.0

- Switched the MCP server URL to HighLevel's Cursor endpoint, `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/cursor/v2`, which exposes the unified `list_locations`, `search_operations`, `describe_operation`, and `execute_operation` tools.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `highlevel` MCP server pointing at `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/`.
- Auth uses OAuth — no Private Integration Token or location ID to configure.
- Logo: HighLevel's official arrow mark, from the gohighlevel.com wordmark.
